captions.detailed: A concrete bell tower designed with a tall, plain rectangular shaft topped by a four-sided pyramidal roof, all finished in a uniform matte gray concrete texture. Inside the arched belfry opening sits a large golden-bronze bell suspended from a dark steel frame yoke. The bell and yoke assembly is designed to swing freely on a horizontal revolute joint relative to the concrete tower structure.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a concrete bell tower with a tall rectangular shaft, an arched belfry window, and a pyramidal roof. Inside the belfry, mount a golden bell on a steel frame yoke using a revolute joint so that it can swing.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base tower using a tall, tapered box or rectangular prism and subtracts an arched opening near the top to create the belfry, then places a square pyramid on top to form the roof. The bell is modeled by revolving a custom profile curve to form the bell shape, which is attached to a rectangular yoke. A revolute joint is defined between the fixed tower part and the swinging bell-yoke assembly, aligned along the horizontal pitch axis.
